title: Search with Filters
content: Build search page with comprehensive filtering. Search input: prominent, with search icon, recent searches dropdown. Result tabs: Top, People, Posts, Tags, Places. People results: user cards with follow button. Posts: post cards with highlighting. Tags: hashtag list with post counts. Filters: date range, from user, has media. Search suggestions as you type.

variants.simple: Create search interface with type filters and result sections.
variants.detailed: Build search page with comprehensive filtering. Search input: prominent, with search icon, recent searches dropdown. Result tabs: Top, People, Posts, Tags, Places. People results: user cards with follow button. Posts: post cards with highlighting. Tags: hashtag list with post counts. Filters: date range, from user, has media. Search suggestions as you type.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive search interface with multi-type results and filtering. Search header: large search input (text-lg py-3 px-4), Search icon inside, clear X button when has value, recent searches dropdown on focus (if empty query). Auto-suggestions: as typing, show suggestions grouped by type (Users, Tags, Topics) with icons, keyboard navigation. Result tabs: horizontal tabs (Top, People, Posts, Tags, Places/Locations), active tab underlined, counts in badges. Top results page: mixed results showing best matches from each type, sections with "See all" links. People results: list or grid of user cards, each with avatar, name, username, bio preview (line-clamp-2), mutual followers count, Follow button, click navigates to profile. Posts results: post cards with search term highlighting (mark tag or bg-yellow-100), show matched content context, standard post engagement. Tags/Hashtags: list showing #hashtag, post count ("12.4K posts"), trending indicator if applicable, click searches that tag. Locations: if applicable, location name, map pin icon, post count. Advanced filters sidebar or dropdown: date range (Any time, Today, This week, This month, Custom), from specific user (@username input), has media toggle (only show posts with images/video), minimum likes/engagement filter, language filter. Filter pills: active filters shown as removable pills above results. Search operators: support "from:username", "has:media", "since:2024-01-01" in query. No results state: helpful message, suggestions (check spelling, try different keywords), related searches. Saved searches: star to save, access from recent searches. Search history: recent searches stored locally, clear history option. Trending: sidebar or below search showing trending topics/hashtags. Pagination: infinite scroll with loading indicator. Performance: debounced search (300ms), show skeleton during load. URL state: search query and filters reflected in URL for sharing/bookmarking. Mobile: full-screen search experience, filter sheet slides up. Accessibility: search input properly labeled, results announced, keyboard navigable.
